description: Source code implementing system property retrieval functions for Raspberry Pi, including reading device model from /proc/device-tree/model and providing system properties such as brand name, model name, friendly name, and platform name.

methods.name: GetModelName
methods.description: Reads and processes the device model name from /proc/device-tree/model, removing revision info and trimming spaces.

methods.name: CopyStringAndTestIfSuccess
methods.description: Copies a string to an output buffer if it fits, returning success status.

methods.name: SbSystemGetProperty
methods.description: Retrieves various system properties based on property ID, including brand name, model name, friendly name, and platform info.
